items.hook: Ignatius of Loyola and six classmates take initial vows, leading to the creation of the Society of Jesus in September 1540.
items.body: Ignatius of Loyola, venerated as Saint Ignatius of Loyola, was a Spanish Basque Catholic priest and theologian, who, with six companions, founded the religious order of the Society of Jesus (Jesuits), and became its first Superior General, in Paris in 1541.
